seo.title: How to Publish Your Manga or Manhwa Online for Free — MangaGreen
seo.description: A step-by-step guide to publishing your manga, manhwa or comic on MangaGreen: create an account, upload your cover and chapters, and reach readers for free.

publishGuide.heading: How to publish your manga on MangaGreen
publishGuide.intro: MangaGreen is a free manga-reading site with a section for original, independently published work. Anyone can publish — no publisher, no portfolio, no fee.
publishGuide.step1Text: Sign up with an email and password, or with Google — takes under a minute.
publishGuide.step2Text: Go to your creator studio and start a new work: title, description, genres and a cover image.
publishGuide.step3Text: Add chapters page by page (JPEG, PNG or WebP). You can prepare several chapters at once and add more any time, even after publishing.
publishGuide.step4Title: 4. Submit for review, then you're live
publishGuide.step4Text: Submit your work for a quick moderation check. Once approved, it appears in the Originals catalog for every visitor to read.
publishGuide.benefit1: Completely free — no fees, no paywalled uploads.
publishGuide.benefit2: You keep every right to your work — MangaGreen only hosts it for readers.
publishGuide.benefit3: A public author profile with a follower count and read stats.
publishGuide.benefit4: Add links to your other social profiles and donation pages.
publishGuide.ctaSecondary: Want the bigger picture first? Read what it's like to be an author here.

seo.title: How to Become a Manga Author — Publish Free on MangaGreen
seo.description: No publisher, no portfolio, no experience required. Learn how independent authors publish manga, manhwa and comics on MangaGreen and build a readership from scratch.

becomeAuthor.heading: How to become a manga author — no publisher required
becomeAuthor.intro: You don't need a publishing deal, an agent, or years of experience to put your work in front of readers. MangaGreen's Originals section exists for exactly that: independent authors publishing directly, for free.
becomeAuthor.who1: You've finished (or are working on) a manga, manhwa or comic and have nowhere to publish it.
becomeAuthor.who2: You want real readers and feedback, not just a folder of files.
becomeAuthor.who3: You'd rather keep full ownership of your work than sign it away to a publisher.
becomeAuthor.whatYouGetHeading: What you get as an author
becomeAuthor.get1: A public author profile — followers, total reads, and your published works in one place.
becomeAuthor.get2: Full ownership of your work, always — MangaGreen never takes any rights over what you publish.
becomeAuthor.get3: Links to your social media and donation pages, right on your profile.
becomeAuthor.get4: Room to grow alongside the platform and its readers, from your very first chapter.
becomeAuthor.communityNote: MangaGreen already hosts original work from a number of independent authors — you'd be joining an existing, growing catalog, not starting from zero.
becomeAuthor.ctaHeading: Ready to publish your first chapter?
becomeAuthor.ctaSecondary: Prefer a step-by-step walkthrough first? See exactly how publishing works.
